subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/252 to be rebased, or replace it with a maintainer-owned narrow fix in openclaw/openclaw?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but the only open implementation candidate is conflicting, cross-repository, and not maintainer-modifiable, so automation should not open a competing fix without maintainer intent.

options.title: Replace the uneditable PR
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow replacement PR in the target repository, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after the replacement exists.

options.title: Ask the contributor to rebase
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR and ask the author to rebase it onto current main with maintainer-modifiable settings if possible.

options.title: Wait without action
options.body: Leave the issue and fork PR open until the contributor returns, accepting that the source-reproducible rendering bug remains unresolved.

recommendation.title: Replace the uneditable PR
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow replacement PR in the target repository, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after the replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original shared-stripper boundary and recently touched the affected helper and UI/TUI consumers.
